basic_details.job_title: OLM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 1115 Block Accountant cum MIS Assistant, Block Manager and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: State Project Manager (Human Resources & Training), State Project Manager (Farm Livelihoods), State Project Manager (Non-Farm Livelihoods) and 54 more
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Livelihoods Mission, Department of Mission Shakti (OLM), Bhubaneswar, has invited applications for 1115 posts in 57 roles. The posts include State Project Manager (Human Resources & Training), State Project Manager (Farm Livelihoods), State Project Manager (Non-Farm Livelihoods), State Project Manager (Value Addition, Market Linkage (Farm & Non-Farm)) and 53 more. The online application is open from 6 November 2026 to 5 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online at the time of registration.

age_limit.age_details: Must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years (as on 1 January 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate/Master Degree in the fields listed for each position (Graduate with PGDCA for Program Assistant; B.Com with PGDCA/Computer Science/IT for Accountant cum MIS Assistant posts; Bachelor's in veterinary science or Fishery for two State Mission Executive posts), with 3+ or 5+ years of relevant experience.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 16,560 to Rs. 72,450, depending on the post

exam_pattern.details: Computer Based Test in English language only. Four options per question; one mark for a correct answer. Negative marking of 0.33 mark for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no deduction. Normalized score is calculated up to seven places after decimal. Provisional answer key is published and objections are allowed within the prescribed period.

how_to_apply: Read the whole advertisement, including the eligibility criteria and the Syllabus Appendix, before filling in the online application form.
Apply online only through www.missionshakti.odisha.gov.in; applications received through any other mode are rejected.
Follow the detailed instructions on the website for registration, document upload and fee payment.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online at the time of registration; SC, ST and PwD candidates pay nil.
Submit the application between 06 Nov 2026 and 05 Dec 2026 (11:55 PM).
Apply once per position; if more than one form is submitted for the same post, only the latest correct form is considered.
Attempt the mock test link that will be placed on the website before the CBT.
Download the e-Admit Card from the website ahead of the examination; none is sent separately.
important_instructions: Application fee is refunded to all candidates who appear in the examination. Exact CBT date, shift and venue will be notified on the e-admit card on the website. Candidates must report with a printed e-Admit Card and a valid original Government photo ID. OLM may change the number of vacancies without notice and may cancel the recruitment process fully or partially. Grievances about the CBT must be e-mailed to [email protected] within 3 days of the candidate's examination.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for OLM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates debarred, terminated or removed from service by OLM and Mission Shakti Department on disciplinary grounds. Candidates whose age is outside the limit; overage relaxation is not allowed to PwD candidates with less than 40% disability.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract is initially for 1 year, which may be renewed based on satisfactory performance and continued as per project requirement. Contractual engagement gives no right to regularisation, permanent absorption or continuation beyond the contractual period. No TA/DA is paid for the examination, document verification or first joining of OLM.

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online at the time of registration.

content_sections.heading: How Will OLM Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test (CBT) Publication of provisional merit list Document Verification (three times the vacancy for each position) Final merit list from normalized CBT marks along with document verification Single CBT paper; no group discussion or personal interview. Three times the vacancy for each position are called for document verification. Final merit list is drawn from normalized CBT marks along with document verification. Tie in marks: senior in age first, then alphabetical order of names.

content_sections.heading: OLM Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test in English language only. Four options per question; one mark for a correct answer. Negative marking of 0.33 mark for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no deduction. Normalized score is calculated up to seven places after decimal. Provisional answer key is published and objections are allowed within the prescribed period.

content_sections.text: H.S.C. or equivalent certificate for age, issued by the Board/Council Master's/Post Graduation/Bachelor's degree certificate from the University Certificate of any other higher qualification Caste certificate by birth for SC/ST/SEBC claims Experience certificate from the competent authority Ex-servicemen: Discharge Certificate and affidavit of not availing the quota in a civil post Permanent Disability Certificate (40% or more) and Sports Certificate, where applicable

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note

Grievances about the CBT must be e-mailed to [email protected] within 3 days of the candidate's examination.

faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a citizen of India. If married, must not have more than one spouse living, unless exempted by the Government. Must have good moral character. Qualification, experience and other conditions must be met by the closing date of online applications.

faq.question: Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates debarred, terminated or removed from service by OLM and Mission Shakti Department on disciplinary grounds. Candidates whose age is outside the limit; overage relaxation is not allowed to PwD candidates with less than 40% disability.

faq.question: How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Computer Based Test (CBT). Publication of provisional merit list. Document Verification (three times the vacancy for each position). Final merit list from normalized CBT marks along with document verification.
